verdict.rationale: Airbyte supports config-as-code versioning via its Terraform provider (docs-2/19) and offers a Connection Timeline for reviewing historical sync/connection events (docs-10), giving real support for the 'version' and 'review' parts of the story. Rollback is only indirectly implied (reverting Terraform state to a prior version) with no dedicated rollback/undo feature documented for connections themselves. Missing for 10: an explicit rollback/undo mechanism for connection or automation state, and independent evidence of Terraform-based revert working in practice.
